method.multiples: Trailing twelve months. EV = month-end price x basic shares outstanding + debt - cash and short-term investments.
method.adj_ebitda: Operating income + D&A + stock-based compensation; EV/adjusted EBITDA shown only where the adjusted margin is 10% or more.
method.aggregate: Median of members; companies count until their exit month.
method.shares: Basic shares outstanding; figures are slightly understated against fully diluted counts.
method.deals: Deal price per share x basic shares, using the last quarter ended at least 30 days before announcement.
method.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL filings; month-end market prices.

transactions.basis: Revenue derived from the buyer's pro forma disclosure
